155400.creator: Rembrandt van Rijn

editorial.note: Here, Rembrandt was chiefly interested in the rider’s pose. The horse and the man helping the rider are rendered only fragmentarily. Rembrandt corrected himself time and again, scratching over earlier lines with powerful strokes.
